title: Changes to a train service
passage: M1: Passengers for the ten fifteen train to Northbridge, please stay in the main waiting area. A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks. No departure platform is confirmed. Do not go to platform six, even if your ticket says to. Check the electronic boards instead. If this delay makes you miss a booked connection, the information desk can arrange your onward trip at no extra charge. Our next update is at ten twenty.
passageZh: 搭乘十點十五分前往北橋的旅客，請留在主要候車區。號誌故障已造成東側軌道封閉。出發月台尚未確認。即使車票上寫著第六月台，也請不要前往，改看電子看板。如果這次延誤讓您錯過已預訂的轉乘，服務台可免費為您安排後續行程。下次更新在十點二十分。
